# Rilla Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Rilla is a fat, roly-poly little creature with long, curly red hair and hazel eyes that wrinkle up when she goes to sleep. She delights in wearing fine clothes, such as starched white embroidered dresses, blue sashes, beaded slippers, and elaborate hats adorned with silk, lace, and flowers.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## Personality

Rilla takes pride in her fine attire and can sometimes strut when showing off a new outfit, showing a somewhat vain nature. She is susceptible to fear when confronted with unusual situations, such as being chased by a large codfish.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)_

## Traits

- Vain about clothes  <sub>[v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)</sub>
- Easily terrified by strange threats  <sub>[v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)</sub>

## History

Rilla spent part of her early childhood at Ingleside, sleeping in the hammock and studying her primer alongside Shirley. Dressed up in her finest clothes to visit the manse, she strutted up the hill while carrying a basket of berries selected for the minister. This behavior provoked Mary Vance, who chased Rilla down the road while brandishing a massive dried codfish. Terrified, Rilla dropped her basket, trampled the berries, and fled screaming until Miss Cornelia rescued her and returned her home crying over her ruined clothes and hurt pride.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 c26 P8](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0008)_
